<!-- install-script-summary -->
> **What the install scripts below do:** each downloads the `imcp2-local` binary for your platform from this release, installs it plus an auto-updater into `~/.cargo/bin`, and adds that directory to your PATH — the shell script by appending a line to every shell profile it can find, the PowerShell script by editing your `Path` registry key. The shell script also compares a checksum baked into itself, but skips that check silently on stock macOS, which has no `sha256sum`; the PowerShell script does not check one at all. Where that shell checksum does run it ships inside the very script being piped to a shell, so on either platform the attestation commands at the end of these notes are what establish provenance — `IMCP2_LOCAL_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1` and `IMCP2_LOCAL_DISABLE_UPDATE=1` opt out of the PATH edits and the updater.
